notes: THE OWNER EDITS THIS FILE. Plans, the feature catalogue, the Free/Pro matrix, settings, term discounts and tax are DATA: change a value here (or in admin) and load it with `node scripts/seed-v3-plans.js --apply` (staging). Price rows are NOT in this file: they are generated from the base monthly rates (settings baseMonthlyPaise.<plan>) and the TERM discount rules below. Anything marked proposed:true is a proposal, not a confirmed business value. A price an admin has already APPROVED is never overwritten by the seed.

graceDays.description: Days after a Pro term ends during which the Pro features still work (proposed).

allowMonthly.description: Allow a 1-month term. Off: only 3, 6 and 12 months can be sold.

renewalReminderDays.description: Days before the end of a term when reminders are sent (proposed).

downgradeBehaviour.description: FALL_TO_FREE: after grace the vendor gets the same track's Free features. KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED: keep the Pro features until staff change the plan.

upgradeProration.description: NONE or PRORATE. Used by the purchase flow in slice 5.1b.

registrationProvisioning.description: When true, a new registration gets the Free plan of the chosen track automatically.

baseMonthlyPaise.handyman_pro.description: Base monthly-equivalent rate in paise (Rs 499). Price rows are generated from this and the TERM discount rules.
